title: VIRTUAL SINGER Chapter1 Episode6 An Unusual Side

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Ichika, you seem a bit down.
Is everything all right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, sorry. I just can't seem to focus.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's all right. Remember, you can talk to me if anything is ever bothering you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What do you think Ichi and Luka are talking about?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was hoping to play through the set once as a group, but they look like they're going to be a while.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm going to go practice out in the hall until they're done.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, okay.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
In that case, how about the two of us practice?
Should we take it from the top?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Saki, is everything all right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
O-Oh, sorry Miku!
I was spacing out there for a minute.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Did you and Ichika have an argument?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: N-No, it's nothing like that! It's just...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's my fault she feels so bad...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So you spoke with Honami?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. I told her I would stop bothering her about spending time together and asking her to join the band.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm sorry, Miku. After everything I said about never giving up, you're probably disappointed in me...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course not. I think what you did was really cool.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You clearly want to spend time with Honami, but after giving it careful thought, you decided to do what was least likely to cause her pain. Isn't that right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Even though that decision is clearly hard on you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's why it's so cool. I don't think there's anything wrong with your decision, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Sorry for the wait, everyone. What do you say we run through everything together?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wha?! Oh, sure!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, are you all right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're not feeling unwell again, are you?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: N-No, I'm fine! I was just so focused on my talk with Miku that you startled me, is all.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I see. Sorry about that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, it's all right!
I was just getting some really great advice from Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well, I have been practicing giving advice like a proper senpai since before you all first arrived, you know.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What? You have?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, she's been thinking hard about different ways she might become a more dependable senpai to everyone.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Like how to sound more grown up. Isn't that right, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really?! Miku did that?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A bit, yeah.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wasn't expecting that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You seem so cool and collected.
I never expected you to have such a cute side to you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: C-Cute? That makes it kind of embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hahaha! We got to see an unexpected side of Miku♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: An unexpected side...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: On first glance, Saki looks like your typical fashion freak, but she's actually pretty normal. I guess you really can't judge a book by its cover.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: H-Hey! You don't have to say it like that!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: C-Calm down, you two.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to see everyone's cheered up a bit.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Still, what if Honami ends up never coming back?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We'll just have to believe. I'm sure everything will work out. She'll rediscover her feelings before you know it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right!
